style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 118 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, marimba, woodblock crunch hits and bright kazoo hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Crunch, crunch! Who's that munching?
Crunch, crunch! What's for lunch?
Guess who's eating, one, two, three,
Crunch, crunch, crunch! Sing with me!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
Black and white, sitting in the shade,
Holding bamboo, a lunch parade!
Bamboo, bamboo, all day long,
The panda crunches to our song!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who's that? Who's that?
Listen to the munching, who is that?

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Crunch, crunch! Who's that munching?
Crunch, crunch! What's for lunch?
Guess who's eating, one, two, three,
Crunch, crunch, crunch! Sing with me!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
A long, long tongue up in the tree,
The giraffe picks leaves, one, two, three!
Up in a tree, a koala, too,
Nibbles leaves, the whole day through!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Munch with your hands! (Munch, munch!)
Crunch like a panda! (Crunch, crunch!)
Stretch like a giraffe! (Reach, reach, reach!)
Now pat your tummy, lunch for each!

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
Big gray trunk wraps the grass so green,
The biggest lunch you've ever seen!
Swish and pull and into the mouth,
The elephant munches north and south!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who's that? Who's that?
Listen to the munching, who is that?

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Crunch, crunch! Who's that munching?
Crunch, crunch! Lunch is fun!
We guessed them all, one, two, three,
Crunch, crunch, crunch! Sing with me!

[Outro - quick and happy]
Crunch, crunch! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Crunch, Crunch! Who's Munching? Sing With Milo
meta.description:
Crunch, crunch! Who's munching? Sing along with Milo the bluebird and guess who is eating lunch: a panda crunching bamboo, a giraffe with a long sticky tongue reaching acacia leaves, a koala nibbling eucalyptus leaves, and an elephant wrapping its trunk around the grass.
A guess-who's-eating animal song for kids. Crunch, munch and sing along. Ages 2-6.

Facts from the San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance Library (giant panda, giraffe, koala and African elephant diet fact sheets).

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Every fact is checked against trusted sources and every script is reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
